notes: Reconciled from blind labelers A and B, who gave the same 7 bends ([1,4], [4,[5,6]], [2,[5,6]], [2,8], [2,16], [2,15], [2,18]); the only difference was the side order of the 2-to-5/6 pair. This is a real scan of part 11979003 rev C (open mesh, t ~1.48 mm, plane rms 0.01-0.03 mm on the top skins and ~0.08 mm on the fragmentary under-skin). Part frame: u = long axis, a = plate-2 normal, b = flange-1 normal. The part is a Z-section rail: plate 2 (a=0, b -51..17), a 90 deg fold down into step wall 5/6 (b ~18.5, ~18 mm tall), a 90 deg fold into wall 4 (a ~-18, b 19..36), then a 90 deg fold down into the 37 mm flange 1 (b ~36.5). Four 90 deg tabs stand up from plate 2: 7/8 from the notch edge (u -70..-34), 12/16 and 13/15 from the u- end edge, and 17/18 from the short chamfer edge. The reconciler checked all prep PNGs, 12 of its own orthographic views, 26 full profile sections (u -135..170), 25 zoomed 1-4 corner sections, 6 u-a sections through the end tabs, 3 sections across the 17/18 fold and 3 horizontal slices at the tab corner. Every long-fold station shows the same rounded staircase profile. The step-wall window (u ~27..41) removes the step wall and both of its fold arcs, and the 1-4 fold has no arc at the ear-24 relief (u ~27..41) or at the flange-1 window (u ~89..153). Each of these folds is still one bend line across a cut-out: the plate 2, wall 4 and flange 1 run unbroken past the cut-outs, so the same rigid flanges meet on one line, in line with README_OVERRIDES ('slot splits flange; fold runs full width'). The end tabs 12/16 and 13/15 are separate free tabs on the same edge, 10 mm apart, so they are two bends. Horizontal slices at a 3..19 show 17/18 separated from 13/15 by a ~1 mm relief gap: a capped thickness edge, with no arc between them. So the 130 deg 13-17 candidate is not a bend. Not bends: the ears 20 and 24 and the u- lug, which are coplanar with flange 1; the twin skins; the thin strips 25, 26 and 27, which are an under-skin fragment and fold-arc or thickness facets; holes, notches and dimples. Both flange 1 and plate 2 are flat over their full length, with no kink or joggle. Note: this PLY is the same mesh as the CONSUMED v2 scan sc_d45186653eed (11979003_C (1).stl): 251501 points, and its patch centroids agree within 0.1 mm. The v2 accepted label split the two step folds at the window into [4,5]/[4,6] and [2,5]/[2,6], which gives 9 bends. Lines run 1: all 7 ok and certain. Every label line sits on the outer arc apex except B1. The ear-24 outer face lies on the OML sharp at u 27..40, so B1's apex search returns an offset of -0.03 mm instead of the expected +1.22 mm, and the B1 line is the OML sharp, about 1.2 mm off the arc apex along the bisector. The per-station apex is +1.22..1.29 elsewhere. No pair or extent override can exclude the ear, and the v2 line accepted for the same mesh is identical.

bends.note: Long ~90 deg fold, wall 4 down into flange 1, outer skins (1 = flange outside, 4 = wall-4 top). Rounded arc at u -121.4..27, 41..89 and 153.5..165.8. The ear-24 relief (u ~27..41) and the flange-1 window (u ~89..153.5, cut at the arc tangent, no arc) interrupt it. It is one bend line along the whole wall-4 length (~287 mm). The label line is at the OML sharp: the apex offset is ~0 because the ear-24 outer face sits on the sharp at u 27..40, about 1.2 mm outside the arc apex.

Lower fold of the Z-step, ~90 deg, step wall 5/6 into wall 4, inner skins (the outer skins 11/14/27 and 25 are fragmentary; 25 covers only u -98..-65). 5 and 6 are the coplanar step wall on either side of the window at u ~27..41, which removes the wall and both arcs. It is one bend line over u -121.4..165 (~286 mm).

Upper fold of the Z-step, ~90 deg, plate 2 down into step wall 5/6, outer skins (2 = plate top, 5/6 = step-wall outside). It crosses the same window at u ~27..41 and is one bend line over u -121.4..165 (~286 mm).

Upright tab 7/8 (~30 mm tall, ~35 mm wide, 3 holes), folded 90 deg up from the notch edge of plate 2 at b ~0, u -70..-34. Inner skins (2 = plate top, 8 = tab face toward the plate). The plate under-skin at the fold is barely segmented (21 and 23 only).
End tab 12/16 (~20x20 mm, hole), folded 90 deg up from the u- end edge of plate 2 at b -9..11, inner skins. It is a separate tab from 13/15, with a 10 mm gap of bare plate edge between them.
End tab 13/15 (~20x20 mm, hole), folded 90 deg up from the u- end edge of plate 2 at b -39.5..-19.5, inner skins. It is in line with 12/16 but is a separate tab.

Corner tab 17/18 (~20 mm), folded 90 deg up from the short chamfer edge of plate 2 (u -122..-107.5), inner skins. A ~1 mm relief gap (capped thickness edge) separates it from 13/15, so the two tabs are not joined by a bend.
